description:
Commerce tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_store_connections: List the e-commerce / CMS store connections (Shopify, Webflow, …) the signed-in user can access, with their id, provider, display name, and 
- list_catalog: Read the products (Shopify) or CMS items (Webflow) from a store connection.
- push_to_store: Write a single value back to one catalog item — e.g.
- enrich_catalog: End-to-end: read a store's catalog, AI-generate an image per item, and push it back (defaults to items missing images).

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).
